title: What If All the Ocean's Plankton Vanished?

scenes.text: What if all the ocean's plankton vanished? Whales would be the least of it.
Phytoplankton are the foundation of the ocean food chain. The tiny animals that eat them would starve first.
Then the fish, seabirds and whales that eat those animals, as the food chain emptied from the bottom up.
On the planet's side, oxygen production would drop by somewhere between fifty and eighty-five percent.
Plankton were making oxygen long before the first land plants appeared.
The smallest living things in the sea are holding up the whole world's breath.

description:
What if all the ocean's plankton vanished?
The sea's food chain would collapse from the bottom, and the planet would lose an estimated 50 to 85 percent of its oxygen production.
